dct_description_sm: The metadata describes a snow survey conducted by the Labrador Highlands Research Group (LHRG) between March 14 and March 16, 2008 in the Mealy Mountains highlands of Labrador. The database compiled includes data on snow density, snow depth, water equivalent, general vegetation/landscape observations, and the over-wintering condition of three climate stations.  The main objective of the snow survey was to obtain a representative sample of snow depth and snow density over the LHRG Mealy Mountains research area. The survey also aims to describe snow patterns as they relate to elevation, vegetation, landforms, and topography. General observations were meant to be recorded along with the data collection activities in order to characterize snow deposition (snow accumulation, snow patterns, and snow coverage), wildlife presence, and vegetation patterns. The automatic climatic stations were inspected along the way to validate winter weather observations recording the local climate.
dct_title_s: Snow Survey Data in Central Labrador (Mealy Mountains)
